explains: The change rewrites round_total in services/billing/app/services/totals.py: the import gains ROUND_HALF_UP and the return line becomes amount.quantize(Decimal("0.01"), rounding=ROUND_HALF_UP). The same two lines were already committed to release/1.x ("Round invoice totals half up") and cherry-picked to release/1.2, but main never received them. Branch matrix over the configured branches main and release/*: release/1.x tip contains every added line, so present; release/1.2 tip contains every added line, so present; main (the base) still has the old return round(amount, 2) and none of the added lines, so pre_change. Version numbers say nothing here: release/1.2 is the older line and still has the fix, so the files are read at each branch tip.
